scope: Persistent sandbox environment and immutable admitted inputs across JS/TS, Python, shell and WASI; native binding SDK and Agent RPC

contracts.precedence: package defaults, sandbox configuration, then execution overrides
contracts.persistence: Head version 3; environment uses the same conditional R2 root publication as policy and filesystem state
contracts.mutation: config.set/patch replace the supplied environment map; omission preserves; empty map clears; empty string remains a value
contracts.authority: create is administrator-only; config mutations require manage; configuration reads require read; environment is not a secret store
contracts.guestIsolation: Guest-local JS process.env and native Python os.environ/getenv receive only the captured map; no Worker bindings or host environment
contracts.queue: Every archived program captures environment before process reservation; delayed delivery and replacement Worker preserve it

migration.paging: at most 25 roots or receipts per native R2 page
migration.integrity: Verify immutable digests before classifying format; corrupt archives terminalize, intact old-format jobs defer before claim
migration.authority: Checkpoint ETag rebases only when prior ETag and full normalized root match; stale authority remains stale
migration.recovery: Native tests cover interrupted conversion, replayed pages and replacement Workers; synthetic checkpoint metadata does not prove historical heap execution
migration.historicalSources: Sources archived by pre-module release 07463e1 were raw UTF-8 JS/TS/Python/shell. Only terminal receipts without authority, deadline or checkpoint retain these verified bytes under historical-source-text-v1; no executable program is fabricated; current JSON markers and queued sources reject malformed bodies.
migration.memory: At most four concurrent objects. Native request-local Semaphore uses eight size-weighted decoding permits, rounded by MiB and capped so oversized bodies take all permits. Checkpoint conversion takes all permits. This is an IO/decoding bound, not proof of maximum Worker memory.

limitations: Full Node and Python os/stdlib are not implemented
Guest map mutation is local and does not persist configuration
Historical interpreter heap compatibility and cross-object old-image admission races remain open
SDK/runtime publication, remote CI and Minutei binding/model delivery remain pending
No production performance or AgentOS cost advantage is established
